title: Telco data-fetch MCP tool contract
description: Input and output schemas for the single read-only fetch_customer_data FastMCP tool over streamable HTTP.

Entity.description: Allowlisted application entity. There is no SQL/table-name passthrough.

FieldAlias.description: Public field alias. Output aliases are documented in x-entity-field-map and filter-only aliases in x-entity-filter-only-field-map; arbitrary columns and JSONB paths are rejected.

oneOf.description: Text or date/time value returned as text.
Explicit null for an allowed nullable field.

Scalar.description: One typed scalar field value; no database-specific objects are returned.

operator.description: Allowlisted comparison; in is an array membership test and gte/lte require an ordered field.

value.description: Typed value compared through a bound parameter; in requires an array of at most 100 scalar values.

oneOf.description: Bounded values used with the in operator.

Filter.description: One allowlisted filter; filters in one request are combined with AND.

direction.description: Sort direction; record ID is always appended as a stable tie-breaker.

Sort.description: Optional sort using an approved field alias.

items.description: Stable ID belonging to the selected entity.

ids.description: Optional stable record IDs. IDs and filters, when both present, are combined with AND.

field_aliases.description: Fields to return. If omitted or empty, the entity's documented safe scalar fields are returned; response records always use the same attributes object shape.

filters.description: Optional allowlisted filters; unknown field/entity combinations return INVALID_FIELD or INVALID_FILTER.

sort.description: Optional approved sort key. Without it, results use the entity's stable source key in ascending order.

limit.description: Maximum rows returned by one call.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page, or null for the first page.

FetchCustomerDataInput.description: Read-only bounded query. Arbitrary SQL, table names, URLs, and unrecognized JSON paths are not accepted.

FeatureMap.description: Stable alias containing the model feature names and typed scalar values from the deployment's validated feature manifest.

AttributeValue.description: A scalar alias value or a named model feature map.

record_id.description: Stable ID in the selected entity namespace.

attributes.description: Only requested or default allowlisted aliases; no ORM or SQL row representation.

records.description: Bounded typed records in deterministic order.

next_cursor.description: Opaque next-page cursor, or null when no page remains.

code.description: Stable data-fetch MCP error code from contracts/errors.md.

message.description: Safe error message with no SQL or driver details.
examples: Field alias is not allowed for this entity.

retryable.description: Whether one retry is allowed by contracts/errors.md.

details.description: Safe field or limit details; empty when not applicable.

x-tool-definition.name: fetch_customer_data
x-tool-definition.description: Read allowlisted customer, billing-cycle, transaction, QoE sample, or persisted prediction data by stable IDs and approved filters.

x-field-alias-semantics.customers.churn_features: Use the latest billing_cycles row by billing_cycle_start, with billing_cycle_id as the stable tie-breaker. Exclude CustomerID, HasChurned, and cycle/date fields; preserve the artifact manifest's remaining semantic feature names.
x-field-alias-semantics.billing_cycles.churn_features: Return the selected cycle's model features with CustomerID, HasChurned, and cycle/date fields excluded.
x-field-alias-semantics.transactions.fraud_features: Return the source model features excluding the fraud target label; leave Plan_Type categorical so prediction-tools can apply training-time one-hot encoding with drop_first semantics.
x-field-alias-semantics.transactions.is_fraud filter-only: May filter labeled transaction rows but is never returned as an input feature to the fraud model.
x-field-alias-semantics.customers.qoe_features: Use the assigned qoe_samples row with the lowest stable qoe_sample_id if more than one sample is assigned. Return raw fields latitude, longitude, elevation_m, visible_satellites, serving_satellites, signal_loss_db, season, and weather; prediction-tools applies the scaler and label encoders.
x-field-alias-semantics.qoe_samples.qoe_features: Return the same eight raw QoE fields as the selected sample; season and weather remain labels until prediction-tools applies the configured label encoders.

x-contract-guarantees.side_effects: Read-only. The MCP service performs no application database mutations.
x-contract-guarantees.errors: Tool errors use McpError with INVALID_ENTITY, INVALID_FIELD, INVALID_FILTER, RESULT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, or DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE.
x-contract-guarantees.timeouts_retries: IDs, filter count, page size, and result rows are bounded. Callers set a deadline and may retry one transient DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE error.
x-contract-guarantees.ordering: Results sort by an approved requested field plus stable record ID, or by stable source key ascending when no sort is specified.
x-contract-guarantees.versioning: Adding an alias or response field is additive. Renaming/removing a tool, entity, alias, or response field requires a new MCP schema version.
